routes.label: registration at a Ministry of Interior centre; the fee paid at an Ecobank branch

note: The Point (25 August 2026): the Ministry of Interior's first phase of registration for the new biometric card, for citizens 18 and over; a first-time card costs D450, paid at any Ecobank branch; holders of a valid card or enrolment printout from the Immigration Department are processed free during the rollout (not modelled). The card's term and the time aren't stated.

sources.title: The Point (The Gambia), Govt launches first phase of new biometric national ID card rollout (25 August 2026)
sources.said: has announced the commencement of the first phase of public registration and issuance of the new Biometric National Identity Cards for citizens aged 18 years and above. ... D450, payable at any Ecobank branch nationwide.
